blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Abstract. X-ray is medicine’s most widely used imaging modality, yet remains among its least quantitative. Unlike volumetric modalities like CT or MRI, X-ray collapses 3D anatomy into a 2D projection, causing structures to overlap and anatomical boundaries to be ambiguous, even to experts. As a result, labeling X-ray databases for training general-purpose segmentation systems is impractical, leaving morphometric and functional X-ray analysis confined to narrow anatomical regions and applications. To this end, we present FleXray, a generalist model for anatomical segmentation across the entire body in clinical X-rays. Instead of curating large, manually annotated X-ray datasets, we build a scalable, physics-based generative X-ray data engine. Using existing 3D whole-body CT segmentation datasets and generative image-editing models, we simulate fully-annotated 2D X-rays with diverse appearances, physiological properties, and imaging geometries. Trained on these simulations, FleXray accurately segments 60 anatomical structures across unseen research datasets and in-the-wild X-rays. We further show that FleXray makes X-rays directly amenable to quantitative analysis, enabling automated measurements for disease grading, robust navigation during X-ray-guided interventions, and data-efficient learning of pathological targets. We release the model, code, a full-body X-ray segmentation dataset, and a local, easy-to-use browser-based tool at https://flexray.csail.mit.edu .
blocks.zh: 摘要. X射线是医学最广泛使用的成像方式,但仍然是数量最少的。 与CT或核磁共振等体积模式不同的是,X射线崩解3D解剖为2D投影,导致结构重叠,解剖边界模糊,甚至对专家而言都是如此. 因此,给X射线数据库贴上用于培训通用分解系统的标签是不切实际的,使得模具和功能的X射线分析仅限于狭窄的解剖区域和应用. 为此,我们提出FleXray, 临床X射线中整个身体解剖分解的通论模型。 我们没有整理大型的,手动附加注释的X射线数据集,而是构建了可扩展的,基于物理学的基因的X射线数据引擎. 利用现有的3D全体CT分解数据集和基因图像编辑模型,我们用多种外观,生理性能,成像几何模型模拟全注解的2D X射线. FleXray对这些模拟进行了训练,精确地将60个解剖结构分解到不见踪影的研究数据集和内光X射线上。 我们进一步表明,FleXray使X射线能够直接进行定量分析,能够自动测量疾病分级,在X射线制导的干预措施中进行强导航,以及数据高效地学习病理目标。 我们在https://flexray.csail.mit.edu发布模型,代码,全体X射线分区数据集,以及一个本地的易用浏览器工具. 。 。 。

blocks.en: Scaling anatomical coverage across the body. Labeled X-ray simulation from CT datasets provides dense anatomical supervision beyond the limited coverage of public X-ray annotations ( Figure 1 b). Prior work has rendered labeled radiographs from segmented CT volumes [ 22 , 25 , 29 , 30 , 31 , 32 ] , but generally targets specific regions, particularly the chest [ 22 , 25 , 29 , 32 ] , standard frontal/lateral projections [ 30 ] , or interactive workflows [ 31 ] . Our goal is instead to scale simulation across the body, patient populations, and continuously varying acquisition parameters and geometries.
blocks.zh: 扩大全身解剖范围。 来自CT数据集的标签X射线模拟提供了密集的解剖监督,超出了公共X射线说明的有限覆盖范围(图1b). 先前的工作使分块CT卷[22,25,29,30,31,32]的标注放射图,但一般针对特定区域,特别是胸部[22,25,29,32],标准前方/边面预测[30],或交互式工作流程[31]. 相反,我们的目标是在整个身体、病人群体以及不断变化的获取参数和几何模型中进行模拟。

blocks.en: We aggregate six CT datasets comprising 2,159 subjects, including 1,597 densely annotated whole-body CTs from the MOOSE dataset [ 3 ] . Because “whole-body” CT scans generally cover only neck-to-knee anatomy, use standardized patient poses, and rarely include pediatric subjects, we add five targeted CT datasets to fill gaps in anatomical and population coverage [ 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 , 37 ] . However, peripheral anatomy remains sparsely imaged in public CT databases. Therefore, we incorporate four real X-ray datasets totaling 764 samples: public hand and foot annotations [ 38 , 39 ] , plus manual forearm and upper-arm annotations that we collect from MURA [ 40 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们汇总了6个CT数据集,包含2,159个主题,包括MOOSE数据集中1,597个注音密集的全体CT[3]. 由于“全身”CT扫描一般只覆盖颈部至膝盖解剖学,使用标准化的病人姿势,很少包括儿科科目,我们增加了五个有针对性的CT数据集,以填补解剖学和人口覆盖方面的空白[33、34、35、36、37]。 然而,在公共CT数据库中,周边解剖学仍然很少成像。 因此,我们纳入了四个真正的X射线数据集,共计764个样本:公共手和脚注释[38、39],加上我们从MURA收集的手动前臂和上臂注释[40]。

blocks.en: Combining these sources requires reconciling differences in anatomical coverage and label definitions between source datasets, such as “spine” in one dataset versus “L1 vertebra” in another. We therefore develop an automatic harmonization pipeline that hierarchically maps dataset-specific ontologies into a common 60-structure label space ( Figure 2 c; Section A.4 ). We restrict this vocabulary to anatomy meaningfully represented in radiographs and exclude structures generally invisible on X-ray, such as the brain and skeletal muscle.
blocks.zh: 综合这些来源,需要调和源数据集在解剖覆盖和标签定义上的差异,例如一个数据集中的“spine”与另一个数据集中的“L1椎”。 因此,我们开发了一个自动统一管道,将特定数据集的分类图绘制成通用的60个结构标签空间(图2c;A.4节)。 我们把这个词汇限制在放射图中有意义的体现的解剖学上,排除X射线上一般看不见的结构,如大脑和骨骼肌肉.

blocks.en: Sampling anatomy across X-ray acquisition conditions. We train on DRRs sampled on-the-fly during training from multiple CT sources ( Figure 1 c,d; Sections A.1 and 2 ). A physics-based analytical X-ray renderer [ 23 ] generates these images from the CT volumes and specified scanner intrinsics and extrinsics. At each training iteration, we sample an anatomical target, viewpoint, field of view, magnification, and projection geometry. We also randomize per-organ attenuation to simulate organ density variations independently of acquisition geometry ( Figure 2 a; Section A.1 ). Because several structures can contribute to the same detector pixel, we project every 3D anatomical mask independently. The resulting targets preserve the dense, overlapping nature of X-ray anatomy rather than imposing a mutually exclusive segmentation map ( Figure 1 c,d; Section A.1 ).
blocks.zh: 通过X射线采集条件进行解剖. 我们在从多个CT来源(图1c,d;A.1和2节)进行飞行中取样的减少灾害风险培训。 一个基于物理学的分析X射线渲染器[23]从CT卷和特定扫描仪的内在和外观产生这些图像. 在每次训练中,我们都会对解剖目标、视角、视野、放大和投影几何进行取样。 我们还将每个器官的衰减随机化,以模拟器官密度变化,独立于获得几何(图2a;A.1节)。 因为几个结构可以促进相同的探测器像素,所以我们独立投影每个3D解剖面具. 由此产生的目标保持了X射线解剖学的密集、重叠性质,而不是强加一个相互排斥的分区图(图1c,d;A.1节)。

blocks.en: Closing the synthetic-to-real appearance gap. Analytical DRRs capture anatomy, geometry, and attenuation, but do not reproduce the full appearance distribution of clinical X-rays. Resolution differences, text overlays and higher-order effects such as dosage, detector response, and scatter remain difficult to model efficiently [ 25 ] . We therefore apply a pretrained language-conditioned generative image editor [ 26 ] to DRRs sampled from the MOOSE dataset to add coverage for higher-order clinical effects ( Figure 2 b; Section A.2 ). The generative editor requires no task-specific fine-tuning and is instructed to introduce clinical appearance while preserving projected anatomy. While generative models have previously been used to synthesize chest X-rays [ 41 , 42 , 43 ] , ours is the first whole-body, label-preserving generative simulation-to-real pipeline for constructing a reusable densely labeled X-ray dataset. Further, because generative editing can occasionally alter anatomy and introduce image-label disagreement, we develop an automatic quality-control pipeline that rejects simulations with gross deviations, removing approximately 4% of enhanced DRRs ( Figures 8 and A.2 ).
blocks.zh: 关闭合成到真实的外观差距. 分析 DRRs 捕捉解剖,几何和衰减,但不复制临床X射线的全部外观分布. 分辨率差异、文字覆盖和剂量、探测器反应和散射等更高顺序效果仍然难以有效建模[25]。 因此,我们对从MOOSE数据集样本中提取的DRRs采用经过预先训练的语言条件基因图像编辑器[26],以增加高阶临床效果的覆盖范围(图2b;A.2节)。 基因编辑器不需要特定任务的微调,并被指示在保留预测解剖学的同时引入临床外观. 虽然基因模型以前曾被用于合成胸X射线[41,42,43],但我们的基因是第一个全体,标注保留基因模拟-真实的管道,用于建造可重复使用的贴有高标签的X射线数据集. 此外,由于基因编辑偶尔可以改变解剖学并引入图像标签分歧,我们开发了一个自动质量控制管道,拒绝带有总偏差的模拟,去除约4%的强化减少灾害风险(图8和A.2).

blocks.en: The final data engine combines three complementary data sources: online analytic projections for anatomical and geometric diversity, quality-controlled generatively-edited DRRs for realistic appearance, and targeted real X-rays for regions poorly represented in CT ( Table 1 ). The utility of the online/offline mixture and the contribution of generative editing are examined separately in Table 8 and Figure 4 c. We release the resulting dataset, including the quality-controlled enhanced DRRs and our MURA annotations, as part of our data release ( Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 最终数据引擎结合了三个互补数据来源:对解剖学和几何多样性的在线分析预测,对现实外观进行质量控制的基因编辑的DR,以及针对在CT中代表性不足的区域进行目标真实X射线(表1). 在线/离线混合物的用途和基因编辑的贡献分别载于表8和图4 c。 作为数据发布的一部分(附录H),我们发布了由此产生的数据集,包括质量控制的强化减少灾害风险和我们的MURA说明。

blocks.en: Training on incomplete and overlapping annotations. We train FleXray on our data engine’s outputs. Combining heterogeneous datasets increases coverage but means that each source annotates only a subset of the 60-structure vocabulary. Treating unannotated structures in a source as absent would therefore mislead training. Instead, we route each source through a loss matched to its annotation coverage, ignoring labels whose status is undetermined. Where absence is anatomically certain, we include impossible structures as explicit negatives; for example, hand structures can safely be supervised as absent in foot X-rays. This dataset-routed objective allows complementary sources to be learned jointly without assuming that unannotated anatomy is absent ( Section B.2 ). Further, X-ray segmentation is intrinsically multi-label at the pixel level due to organ overlap. We therefore derive supervision directly from the projection geometry, mark every organ intersected by a ray as positive, and predict an independent probability map for each structure ( Figure 1 c,d; Sections B.1 and B.2 ).
blocks.zh: 关于不完整和重叠说明的培训。 我们用数据引擎的输出来训练FleXray。 组合各式各样的数据集可增加覆盖面,但意味着每个源只对60个结构词汇的一个子集进行注释。 因此,将来源中未经说明的结构视为不存在,会误导培训。 相反,我们通过一个与其注解覆盖相称的损失来引导每个来源,而忽略其状态尚未确定的标签。 如果从解剖学上确定不存在,我们就把不可能的结构列为明显的负数;例如,手结构可以安全地作为脚X射线的缺失而加以监督。 这一数据集的路由目标允许在不假定没有附加说明的解剖学的情况下,共同学习补充来源(B.2节)。 此外,由于器官重叠,X射线片断在像素水平上本质上是多标签的. 因此,我们直接从投影几何得到监督,将每个被射线交叉的器官标为正数,并预测每个结构的独立概率图(图1c,d;B.1和B.2节)。

blocks.en: The final FleXray system is an ensemble of five independently trained networks exposed to different proportions of generatively enhanced data, with each network using 16-sample test-time augmentation ( Sections B.1 and C.3 ). Ensembling and test-time-augmentation aim to broaden the data distribution at training and inference, respectively, both seeking to improve robustness on in-the-wild X-rays ( Figure 9 ). For the ablations and finetuning experiments that follow, we use a single model— FleXray (single) —trained with equal proportions of standard and generatively enhanced X-rays. Together, this pipeline converts heterogeneous CT and X-ray datasets into a harmonized source of dense supervision spanning anatomy, populations, projection geometries, and clinical appearance, enabling the training of full-body X-ray segmentation networks that require no user prompts or acquisition metadata at inference.
blocks.zh: 最终的FleXray系统是由5个经过独立训练的网络组成的组合体,暴露在不同比例的基因增强数据中,每个网络使用16个样本测试时间增强(B.1和C.3节). 试射时间和试射时间分别旨在扩大培训和推断的数据分布,同时力求提高光圈内X射线的强度(图9)。 对于随后的锻炼和微调实验,我们使用一个单一的模型——FleXray(单一)——以同样比例的标准和基因增强的X光进行训练。 这一管道共同将不同的CT和X射线数据集转换成一个统一的密集监管来源,涵盖解剖学、人口、投影几何和临床外观,从而能够培训全体X射线分解网络,无需用户提示或推断获得元数据。

blocks.en: Quantitative segmentation evaluation. We evaluate FleXray on eight held-out X-ray datasets spanning the limbs, pelvis, spine, and chest, spanning multiple fields-of-view and populations ( Figure 3 ; Table 4 ). Where possible, we compare against existing X-ray segmentation frameworks that aim to generalize to the target dataset, including PAXray [ 29 ] , TotalSegmentator2D [ 30 ] , and FluoroSAM [ 31 ] . PAXray and TotalSegmentator2D are evaluated only on supported anatomical regions, whereas FluoroSAM is evaluated throughout but receives a simulated ground-truth-derived text prompt and positive click for each target. As in-domain supervised upper bounds, we also train a separate nnU-Net on the training split of each evaluation dataset ( Section C.4 ). Predictions are post-processed to match dataset-specific annotation conventions ( Section C.1 ) and evaluated using Dice score ( Section C.2 ).
blocks.zh: 定量分解评价. 我们评价FleXray在横跨四肢、骨盆、脊椎和胸部、横跨多个视场和人群的8个悬浮X射线数据集(图3;表4)。 在可能的情况下,我们比较了旨在对目标数据集进行概括化的现有X射线分解框架,包括PAXray [29]、TotalSegmentator 2D [30]和FluorosAM [31]。 PAXray和TotalSegmentator2D只在支持解剖的区域进行评价,而FluorosAM则在整个区域进行评价,但每个目标都得到模拟地面真实生成的文本即时和正点击。 作为域内监管的上界,我们还就每个评价数据集的培训划分问题培训一个单独的NNU-Net(C.4节)。 预测是经过后处理的,以便与数据集特定注释惯例(C.1节)相匹配,并使用Dice分数(C.2节)进行评估。

blocks.en: Across all eight datasets, FleXray achieves an equal-dataset mean Dice of 0.875 and significantly outperforms every supported baseline on seven datasets ( Figure 3 , left; all p < < 0.001 on six datasets). On VinDr-Rib, its performance is not significantly different from PAXray ( p =0.146), a baseline specifically developed for chest X-rays. Qualitatively, FleXray remains anatomically coherent despite large differences in field of view, projection angle, image polarity, acquisition modality, and patient population ( Figure 3 , right).
blocks.zh: 在所有8个数据集中,FleXray实现了平均0.875的等值数据集,并大大超过7个数据集的每个支持基线(图3,左;所有p < 0.001,六个数据集)。 在VinDr-Rib上,其性能与PAXray(p=0.146)没有显著区别,这是专门为胸X射线而制定的基准. 在定性上,FleXray在解剖学上仍然保持连贯,尽管在视野,投影角度,图像极性,获取方式,以及病人群体上存在很大差异(图3,对).

blocks.en: Although FleXray never trains on any of these evaluation datasets, its performance is comparable to that of supervised nnU-Nets trained for that specific dataset. FleXray trails these in-domain networks by only 0.039 Dice on average (0.875 versus 0.914), and on DeepFluoro it performs better than the nnU-Net trained directly on the dataset (0.915 versus 0.866). This is due to DeepFluoro containing little training data and spanning a wide range of acquisition angles, illustrating the advantages of learning from a broad synthetic acquisition distribution.
blocks.zh: 尽管FleXray从未在任何这些评价数据集上进行训练,但其性能与为该特定数据集培训的受监督的nnU-Net相比。 FleXray 仅以 0.039 跟踪这些域内网络 在DeepFluoro上,它的表现优于直接接受数据集培训的NDU-Net(0.915比0.866)。 这是由于DeepFluoro包含的训练数据很少,并且跨越了广泛的获取角度,说明了从广泛的合成获取分布中学习的好处.

blocks.en: However, while held-out, academic datasets still represent relatively curated imaging conditions. We therefore also apply FleXray to “in-the-wild” radiographs collected from Radiopaedia ( Figure 4 a). These examples span frontal, lateral, and oblique views; unilateral and bilateral examinations; adult and pediatric anatomy; and large differences in field of view. Across these heterogeneous cases, FleXray continues to produce qualitatively coherent anatomical segmentations, providing evidence that its robustness extends beyond benchmark datasets.
blocks.zh: 然而,学术数据集虽然被搁置,但仍然代表着相对成熟的成像条件. 因此,我们还将FleXray应用于从Radiopaedia收集的“无线”放射图(图4a)。 这些例子包括:正面、横向和斜视;单边和双边检查;成人和儿科解剖学;以及视界的巨大差异。 在所有这些不同的情况下,FleXray继续产生质量上连贯的解剖分解,提供证据表明其强性超出了基准数据集。

blocks.en:
Robustness to acquisition angle. Clinical radiographs are frequently acquired at oblique angles for certain examinations, whereas most X-ray segmentation datasets and models focus entirely on standard frontal and lateral views [ 44 ] . We isolate this factor using DeepFluoro, which provides both labels and ground-truth acquisition angles for each X-ray.
Across the 213 frames from its two held-out test subjects, we measure per-structure Dice as a function of geodesic distance from the frontal view ( Figure 4 b). Overall, FleXray achieves a mean Dice of 0.915 [0.912, 0.919], with 5 ∘ -bin averages ranging from 0.925 [0.921, 0.928] at 5–10 ∘ to 0.888 [0.847, 0.923] at 35–40 ∘ . Femurs, hips, and sacrum remain within 0.05 Dice of their frontal-view performance across the full pose range. Only the lumbar spine, which becomes increasingly small and foreshortened in oblique views, shows a larger decline, from 0.840 [0.829, 0.850] within 15 ∘ of frontal ( n = = 136) to 0.751 [0.690, 0.805] beyond 25 ∘ ( n = = 27). In comparison, the applicable baselines (FluoroSAM and TotalSegmentator2D) are both less accurate and less stable, reaching mean Dice scores of 0.711 [0.701, 0.722] and 0.371 [0.357, 0.386], respectively. Thus, FleXray remains robust well beyond the standard acquisition angles represented in most X-ray datasets.
blocks.zh:
强壮到获取角度。 临床放射图经常以斜角获取,用于某些检查,而大多数X射线分区数据集和模型则完全侧重于标准前视和横向视[44]. 我们用DeepFluoro来隔离这个因子,它为每次X光都提供了标签和地面真实获取角度.
在其两个搁置试验对象的213个框架中,我们测量每个结构的凹槽,作为从前视线的大地测量距离的一种函数(图4b)。 总体而言,FleXray的平均值为0.915 [0.912, 0.919],5   - 宾平均值从 0.925 [0.921, 0.928] 5–10 ∘到 0.888 [0.847, 0.923] 35–40 ∘. 羽毛,臀部,和萨科姆在全姿势范围前视力表现的0.05分之内. 只有腰脊在斜视中变得越来越小和前身变矮,显示出较大的下降,从前额(n==136)的15 ∘之内的0.840 [0.829,0.850]下降到25 ∘之后的0.751 [0.690,0.805] (n==27). 相比之下,适用的基线(FluorosAM和TotalSegmentator2D)既不准确,也不太稳定,分别达到0.711 [0.701,0.722] 和0.371 [0.357,0.386] 的平均得分. 因此,FleXray仍然强劲,远远超出了大多数X射线数据集所体现的标准获取角度。

blocks.en:
Ablating generative enhancement. To isolate whether generative X-ray enhancement provides useful supervision in addition to our augmentation pipeline, we remove it as an augmentation. While the equal-dataset average Dice is unchanged (0.870 enhanced versus 0.870 raw; n = = 1,458), we find substantial benefits in regions that are challenging to render faithfully in rendered DRRs. For example, as the lower ribs on VinDr-Rib are obfuscated by abdominal organs in standard DRRs ( Figure 4 c), ribs 5–10 all improve with generative enhancement (+3.9 [+2.2, +5.8] pooled, p < < 0.001), with gains increasing from +2.5 Dice points at rib 5 to +7.4 at rib 10.
These results suggest that generative editing contributes useful appearance variation beyond conventional augmentation, with substantial benefit to specific anatomical structures.
blocks.zh:
分泌基因增强 为了隔离基因X射线增强除了我们的增强管之外是否还提供了有用的监督,我们把它作为增强管去除. 虽然均值数据集的平均剂量没有变化(0.870增强值与0.870原始值之比;n = = 1 458),但我们发现,在那些难以忠实完成减少灾害风险的区域中,我们却获得了很大的好处。 例如,由于VinDr-Rib的下肋骨在标准的DRR(图4c)中被腹部器官遮盖,5-10肋骨均因基因增强而改善(+3.9[+2.2,+5.8]集合,p < 0.001),增益从+2.5增加. 肋骨5至+7.4的分数为肋骨10.
这些结果表明,基因编辑有助于超出常规增殖的外观变化,对具体的解剖结构有很大好处。

blocks.en: Ablating attenuation randomization. We now test whether per-label attenuation randomization ( Section A.1 ) improves robustness. Averaged across datasets, the effect is modest as equal-dataset mean Dice increases only from 0.863 to 0.870 with randomization. However, in pathological datasets, such as DarwinCVD19, we find that lung Dice increases from 0.907 to 0.922 ( n = = 952, p < < 0.001). Stratifying by diagnosis ( Figure 4 d) shows that this gain is negligible in healthy lungs (0.945 to 0.946, n = = 241), but concentrated in pneumonia cases where the lungs are dense and Dice rises from 0.894 to 0.914 ( n = = 711, p < < 0.001; Welch t -test between groups, p < < 0.001). Correspondingly, the number of pneumonia images below 0.85 Dice falls from 122 to 50. Therefore, as intentionally designed, attenuation randomization improves robustness when pathology substantially alters radiographic density.
blocks.zh: 分解衰减随机化. 我们现在检验每个标签的减值随机化(A.1节)是否提高强度。 平均跨数据集,效果微乎其微,因为等数据集平均值Dice仅随随机化从0.863增加到0.870. 然而,在达尔文CVD19等病理数据集中,我们发现肺虱从0.907增加到0.922(n===952,p < 0.001). 通过诊断(图4d)发现,这种增益在健康的肺脏中可忽略不计(0.945至0.946,n==241),但集中在肺部密集且底斯从0.894上升到0.914的肺炎病例中(n===711,p < 0.001;welch t - t - test between groups,p < 0.001)。 相应地,0.85分以下的肺炎影像数量从122个下降到50个. 因此,如有意设计的那样,当病理大大改变辐射密度时,衰减随机化会提高强度。

blocks.en: We next evaluate whether FleXray is useful beyond segmentation itself. We consider three complementary modes of reuse: directly converting its anatomical masks into clinical measurements, using them as semantic priors within downstream workflows, and adapting it for new anatomical and pathological targets.
blocks.zh: 接下来我们评价FleXray除了分解本身是否有用. 我们考虑三种互补的再利用方式:直接将其解剖口罩转化为临床测量,在下游工作流程中将其作为语义学前科,并适应新的解剖和病理目标.

blocks.en: FleXray predictions quantify scoliosis severity within inter-rater variability. Scoliosis severity is routinely quantified from X-rays using the Cobb angle, a standard measure of spinal curvature [ 47 , 48 ] . However, manual measurements vary by approximately 3–5 ∘ within observers and 6–7 ∘ between observers [ 49 , 50 ] . We therefore ask whether FleXray can recover this measurement directly from its vertebral segmentations on the Accurate Automated Spinal Curvature Estimation (AASCE) MICCAI 2019 challenge dataset [ 51 ] , which provides reference Cobb-angle annotations on anterior-posterior spinal X-rays. Following clinical guidelines [ 50 ] , we stratify curves as low ( ≤ \leq 20 ∘ ), moderate (20–40 ∘ ), or severe ( > > 40 ∘ ). Predictions with fewer than three usable vertebrae are reported separately as failures and the segmentation to Cobb angle conversion is detailed in Figure 5 a and Section D.1 .
blocks.zh: FleXray 预测在介质间可变性中量化了石化严重性. 骨质疏松性严重性通常使用Cobb角度从X射线中量化,这是脊柱曲面的标准度量[47,48]. 然而,在观察员内部,人工测量的差别约为3-5,在观察员之间则有6-7。 因此,我们询问FleXray能否直接从它的脊椎分解中恢复这一测量值,这些分解位于2019年MICCAI挑战数据集(AASCE)上,该数据集提供了前置脊椎X射线的参考Cobb角说明. 遵循临床指南[50],我们把曲线分层为低(≤\leq 20 ),中(20–40∘),或严重( > 40 ). 可用椎骨少于3个的预测作为故障单独报告,对Cobb角度转换的分区详见图5a和D.1节。

blocks.en: On AASCE, FleXray produces a measurable curve with no failures for all 218 images and achieves the lowest overall error, with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 5.13 ∘ [4.55, 5.74] ( Figure 5 b). TotalSegmentator2D fails on 1 image and reaches 6.38 ∘ [5.51, 7.32] MAE on the remainder, compared with 24.94 ∘ [22.06, 27.91] for PAXray, which fails on 7 images, and 31.82 ∘ [28.19, 35.58] for FluoroSAM, which fails on 42. FleXray also attains the lowest MAE in every severity stratum (2.08 ∘ , 4.12 ∘ , and 7.50 ∘ for low, moderate, and severe curves), significantly so in every comparison ( p ≤ \leq 0.024), except against TotalSegmentator2D for severe curves (7.87 ∘ ; p = = 0.70).
blocks.zh: 在AASCE上,FleXray产生一个可测量的曲线,所有218个图像都没有故障,并实现最低的总误差,平均绝对误差(MAE)为5.13 ∘[4.55,5.74](图5b). 共计 D在1幅图像上失败,其余部分达到6.38 QQ [5.51, 7.32] MAE,而PaXray的24.94 QQ [22.06, 27.91],在7幅图像上失败;FluorosAM的31.82 QQ [28.19, 35.58],在42幅图像上失败. FleXray在每条重度曲线中也达到最低的MAE(2.08 ∘,4.12 ∘,7.50 ∘,低度,中度和重度曲线),除对重度曲线的TotalSegmentator2D(7.87 ∘,p = 0.70)外,在每次比较中都明显达到最低的MAE(p ^\leq 0.024).

blocks.en: Importantly, FleXray’s error lies below the 6–7 ∘ variability between expert observers. For moderate curves, which are particularly relevant to clinical planning [ 52 ] , its 4.12 ∘ MAE also falls within the 3–5 ∘ variability of repeated measurements by a single expert. Overall, 61% [55, 67] of estimates fall within 5 ∘ of the reference and 88% [83, 92] within 10 ∘ . Thus, general-purpose anatomical segmentations derived from FleXray can be used to power application-specific quantitative measurements and grading workflows.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,FleXray的误差低于专家观察员之间的6-7-QQ差异。 对于与临床规划特别相关的中度曲线[52],其4.12 MAE也属于单个专家重复测量的3–5 的可变性范围. 总体来看,61%[55、67]的估计数在参考文献的5%以内,88%[83、92]在10 以内。 因此,从FleXray衍生出来的普通用途解剖分解可用于为应用特定量化测量和分级工作流程提供动力.

blocks.en: FleXray segmentations improve the robustness of 2D/3D registration. Many image-guided procedures use preoperative 3D imaging for planning but rely on live 2D X-ray fluoroscopy during intervention for navigation [ 53 , 54 , 55 , 56 , 57 , 58 ] . Aligning these images through 2D/3D registration can recover 3D anatomical context during navigation [ 59 ] . Currently, conventional methods optimize image similarity between a real intraoperative X-ray and a DRR rendered from a candidate 3D pose from the preoperative CT [ 60 , 61 , 45 , 62 , 63 , 64 , 46 ] . However, many of the same challenges with poor soft-tissue contrast and overlapping anatomy make this registration objective highly non-convex, leaving iterative registration highly susceptible to local minima without proper initialization [ 65 , 23 , 66 ] .
blocks.zh: FleXray的分解提高了2D/3D注册的稳健性. 许多图像制导程序使用预操作的3D成像进行规划,但在导航干预时依赖活的2D X射线氟化镜[53、54、55、56、57、58]。 通过2D/3D注册来调整这些图像,可以在导航过程中恢复3D解剖上下文[59]. 目前,常规方法优化了操作前CT中候选人3D姿势产生的真正内置X射线和DRR的图像相似性[60、61、45、62、63、64、46]。 然而,由于软问题对比不佳和解剖学重叠,许多同样的挑战使这一登记目标高度非汇合,使得迭代登记极易受到当地微型公司的影响,而没有适当初始化[65、23、66]。

blocks.en: We therefore use FleXray’s anatomical predictions as auxiliary semantic supervision for registration. Specifically, we add a bidirectional Chamfer loss [ 67 , 68 ] that aligns distance transforms of structures segmented in the real X-ray with projections of the corresponding structures from the preoperative CT ( Section D.2 ). We incorporate this loss into xvr , an image-based iterative X-ray to volume registration pipeline [ 46 ] . Unlike image similarity, whose useful gradient can disappear when the DRR and X-ray have little overlap, the segmentation-based Chamfer term remains informative from substantially worse initial poses ( Section D.2 ).
blocks.zh: 因此,我们将FleXray的解剖预测作为注册的辅助语义监督. 具体地说,我们增加了一个双向Chamfer损失[67,68],使在真X射线中分离的结构的距离变换与从操作前的CT(D.2节)对相应结构的预测保持一致。 我们把这个损失纳入xvr,一个基于图像的迭代X射线到体积登记管道[46]. 与图像相似性不同,当减少灾害风险和X射线几乎没有重叠时,其有用的梯度可以消失,基于分化的Chamfer术语仍然从更糟糕的初始形式中提供信息(D.2节)。

blocks.en: We evaluate on all 213 held-out DeepFluoro X-rays with ground-truth C-arm poses starting from two possible initialization strategies ( Figure 5 c). Performance is measured using mean target registration error (mTRE) ( Section C.2 ) and gross failure rate (GFR), defined as the fraction of registrations with mTRE greater than 10 mm 10\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{m} . From a manually selected frontal pose, a common clinical initialization [ 45 ] , the median starting error is 324.5 mm with 100% GFR. Image-based optimization alone remains trapped at a median mTRE of 335.3 mm (86.4% GFR). However, adding the FleXray-enabled Chamfer loss reduces median mTRE to 1.2 mm ( p < < 0.001) and GFR to 12.7% ( Figure 5 d).
blocks.zh: 我们从两个可能的初始化战略(图5c)开始,评估所有213个带有地面真C臂的深福路罗X射线。 性能使用平均目标注册误差(mTRE)(C.2节)和总故障率(GFR)来衡量,其定义为mTRE大于10mm 10\text~,}\mathrm{mmathrm{m}的注册比例. 从人工选择的正面姿势,常见的临床初始化[45],中间起始误差为324.5毫米,其中GFR为100%. 基于图像的优化本身仍然被困在335.3毫米(86.4%的GFR)的中位数mTRE. 然而,加上FleXray带动的Chamfer损失,MTRE中位数降至1.2毫米(p < 0.001),GFR降至12.7%(图5d)。

blocks.en: To measure potential benefits over the state-of-the-art, we next initialize optimization using a foundation model trained to predict C-arm pose directly from an X-ray [ 46 ] , yielding a median initial mTRE of 76.6 mm (100% GFR). Image-based refinement already reduces GFR to 7.0%, but leaves eight catastrophic failures with errors between 93 and 1,628 mm. Adding the Chamfer term recovers all eight cases with mTRE > > 50 mm and brings each below 10 mm, reducing overall GFR to 3.3% and worst-case mTRE to 21 mm. This additional semantic loss does not sacrifice accuracy on cases that already register successfully: among the 198 frames solved by both methods, median mTRE remains 1.01 versus 1.04 mm ( Figure 5 d). Thus, FleXray automatically injects useful semantic information into existing 2D/3D registration methods, widening the capture range of conventional optimization while suppressing catastrophic failures from learned initializations.
blocks.zh: 为了衡量对最新技术的潜在好处,我们接下来将使用一个基础模型启动优化,该模型经过培训,可直接从X射线[46]中预测C-臂的作用,得出76.6毫米(100%GFR)的中位数。 基于图像的改进已经将GFR降低到7.0%,但留下8个灾难性故障,误差在93至1,628毫米之间. 添加Chamfer一词后,用mTRE回收所有8个病例 > > 50毫米,并分别带来低于10毫米,总体GFR降低到3.3%,最坏情况mTRE降低到21毫米. 这种额外的语义损失不会牺牲已经成功登记的案例的准确性:在两种方法解决的198帧中,mTRE中位数仍然是1.01,而1.04毫米(图5d)。 因此,FleXray将有用的语义信息自动注入现有的2D/3D注册方法,扩大了常规优化的捕捉范围,同时抑制了从学到的初始化中产生的灾难性失败.

Gray显示共享预测,紫色和teal显示前景,仅由FleXray和nnU-Net分别预测,破碎的黄色轮廓显示地面真相. 骰子分数使用完整图像. d,利用1,305个训练图像的分数,在BTXRD上的交叉比对0.5(AP50)探测平均精度。 该测试集包含281个肿瘤阳性放射图中的354个肿瘤,没有正常病例. e,BTXRD AP50按地面-真伪界框区分级. blocks.en:
FleXray adapts to unseen segmentation tasks with limited annotations. Finally, we ask whether FleXray provides a useful initialization for targets that were never part of its pretraining vocabulary. We study adaptation to fine-grained pelvic anatomy in pediatric hip dysplasia (MTDDH [ 70 ] ) and bone-tumor detection (BTXRD [ 71 ] ).
Because accurate anatomical delineation supports hip-dysplasia measurements [ 72 ] , we evaluate MTDDH using Dice. For BTXRD, where the primary focus is detecting individual tumors, we use detection average precision at an intersection-over-union of 0.5 (AP50; Section D.3 ). We replace the output head of FleXray (single) with a randomly initialized task-specific segmentation head and fine-tune the full network on 1%, 5%, 10%, 50%, or 100% of each training split. We compare against nnU-Net [ 69 ] trained from random initialization ( Section D.3 ), representing a well tuned segmentation baseline.

FleXray以有限的说明适应看不见的分割任务. 最后,我们询问FleXray是否为从未成为其预训词汇一部分的目标提供了有用的初始化. 我们研究了在儿科臀部脱血(MTDDH [70])和骨瘤检测(BTXRD [71])中,对细纹骨盆解剖学的适应性.
因为准确的解剖学划界支持臀部-呼吸道测量[72],所以我们用Dice来评价MTDDH. 对于BTXRD,主要重点是检测单个肿瘤,我们在0.5的交叉结合时使用检测平均精度(AP50;D.3节)。 我们把FleXray(单)的输出头换成随机初始化的任务特定分区头,并在每次训练分拆的1%,5%,10%,50%或100%上对全网络进行微调. 我们比较了NNU-Net[69]从随机初始化(D.3节)中培训的,这代表着一个调整良好的分区基线。

blocks.en: The benefit of initialization from FleXray is largest when labels are scarce ( Figure 6 ). On MTDDH, using only 1% of the training set (6 patients), finetuned FleXray reaches a mean Dice of 0.896 [0.892, 0.900] versus 0.867 [0.852, 0.879] for nnU-Net, with the largest improvement on the ilium (0.948 [0.946, 0.951] versus 0.907 [0.893, 0.920]). As supervision increases, the gap asymptotically narrows, a finding consistent with the few-shot segmentation literature [ 73 ] . The harder BTXRD task shows a larger and more persistent advantage. With 10% of the training set ( ∼ \sim 130 cases), finetuned FleXray reaches 23% AP50 versus 7% for nnU-Net, a difference of 16 percentage points [11, 22]. With only 1% (13 cases), performance is 5% versus 0.4%, and nnU-Net does not match FleXray’s 5%-budget AP50 until it receives 50% of the training set ( Figure 6 d).
blocks.zh: FleXray的初始化好处最大,因为标签稀缺(图6). 在MTDDH上,仅使用1%的训练集(6名患者),微调FleXray达到0.896[0.892,0.900]对nU-Net的0.867[0.852,0.879]的平均值,对ilium的改进最大(0.948[0.946,0.951]对0.907[0.893,0.920]). 随着监督的增加,差距的不对称缩小,这个发现与几发分片的文献一致[73]. BTXRD任务越难,就显示出更大和更持久的优势. 由于培训组合的10%(\\\sim 130个病例),FleXray的微调达到23%的AP50比NNU-Net的7%,相差16个百分点[11,22]. 在只有1%(13例)的情况下,业绩是5%对0.4%,NNU-Net在接受50%的培训之前,不匹配FleXray5%的预算AP50(图6d)。

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en: Across all held-out segmentation datasets, FleXray matched or exceeded prior methods without requiring label-set-specific models (as in TotalSegmentator2D [ 30 ] ) or per-structure prompts (FluoroSAM [ 31 ] ), with no method being a consistent second place. FleXray’s performance also approached that of dataset-specific custom networks trained directly on the evaluation domains. These results suggest that successful synthetic training depends less on reproducing any single notion of realism than on achieving broad coverage in training of the anatomical, geometric, and appearance variation encountered at deployment. For example, physics-based projection alone transfers poorly to real radiographs, while appearance randomization accounts for most of the gain ( Section E.2.3 ). Generative X-ray enhancement provides additional benefit where analytic rendering is least faithful ( Figure 4 c), whereas real X-ray datasets of the limbs (constituting only 4% of training iterations) close gaps in the coverage offered by public CT datasets ( Section E.2.4 ).
blocks.zh: 在所有被搁置的分区数据集中,FleXray匹配或超越了先前的方法而不需要标签设定特定模型(如TotalSegmentator2D [30])或每个结构的提示(FluorosAM [31]),没有方法成为一致的第二位. FleXray的成绩也接近于直接接受评价领域培训的数据集定制网络。 这些结果表明,成功的合成培训并不取决于复制任何单一的现实主义概念,而取决于在培训解剖学、几何学和部署时遇到的外观变化方面实现广泛的覆盖。 例如,仅基于物理的投影就向真实的射电图转移不良,而外观随机化则占了大部分收益(E.2.3. 基因X射线增强在分析渲染的可靠性最低的情况下提供了额外好处(图4c),而实际的四肢X射线数据集(只占培训迭代的4%)则缩小了公共CT数据集提供的覆盖面差距(E.2.4节)。

blocks.en: The broader value of FleXray is not just the segmentation masks themselves, but the quantitative workflows they make possible. For example, its vertebral predictions disease grading measurements to within inter-rater variability. In 2D/3D registration, the same anatomical predictions provide semantic gradients where image similarity becomes uninformative, removing all catastrophic optimization failures (mTRE > > 50 mm) without degrading successful registrations. For unseen segmentation targets, FleXray provides a robust initialization that is most useful when labels are scarce. These examples underscore a broader opportunity: one anatomy can be extracted reliably from routine radiographs, X-rays can support analyses that have traditionally been confined to time consuming or ionizing volumetric modalities such as MRI or CT, respectively. Further, retrospective archives and biobanks can now be mined for anatomical biomarkers, longitudinal changes, and associations between anatomy, disease, treatment, and outcomes without requiring dedicated prospective imaging or task-specific annotation for every new analysis or region of interest.
blocks.zh: FleXray的广义价值不仅仅是片段遮掩自己,而是它们带来的量化工作流程. 例如,它的脊椎预测将疾病分级测量结果推向了各率之间的可变性。 在2D/3D的注册中,同样的解剖预测提供了图像相似性变得无成形的语义梯度,消除了所有灾难性优化失败(mTRE > 50mm)而不降低成功注册. 对于看不见的分割目标,FleXray提供了强大的初始化,在标签稀缺时最有用. 这些例子突出了一个更广泛的机会:一个解剖学可以可靠地从常规的放射图中提取,X射线可以支持传统上局限于时间消耗或电离体积模式的分析,如核磁共振或CT. 此外,现在可以为解剖学生物标记、纵向变化以及解剖学、疾病、治疗和结果之间的关联挖掘追溯档案和生物库,而无需对每一新的分析或感兴趣的区域作专门的未来成像或具体任务说明。

blocks.en: We release a first-of-its-kind enhanced DRR dataset and accompanying training resources ( Appendix H ). The collection varies anatomy, projection geometry, and appearance across the body and further includes quality-controlled generatively-enhanced DRRs, our manual forearm and humerus annotations for MURA, and seven re-distributable real X-ray sources in the format used by FleXray. We also fix the image-level splits and exclusions for every evaluation dataset, allowing future methods to be compared on identical held-out samples. Because our results indicate that performance depends strongly on the training distribution, we expect this resource to lower the barrier to the development of pan-anatomy X-ray models beyond the architecture studied here.
blocks.zh: 我们发布了首批增强的减少灾害风险数据集和配套培训资源(附录H)。 藏品各异解剖,投影几何,全身外观,并进一步包括质量控制的基因增强DRR,我们MURA的手动前臂和humerus说明,以及FleXray所使用的格式的七个可再分配的真X射线源. 我们还确定每个评价数据集的图像级别划分和排除,以便今后在相同的搁置样本上进行比较。 因为我们的结果显示,性能在很大程度上取决于训练的分布,所以我们期望这种资源能将发展泛解剖学X射线模型的障碍降低到这里研究的架构之外.

blocks.en: Prior DRR-based segmentation methods use a single projection model, either parallel [ 29 ] or cone-beam [ 32 , 31 ] , and, to our knowledge, train on a finite set of DRRs rendered before training. FleXray combines offline-generated DRRs with online rendering that varies projection models and acquisition parameters during training. Our attenuation randomization also differs from AnyCXR [ 32 ] , which shares scaling factors across soft-tissue structures and independently perturbs only individual vertebrae and ribs. We instead draw an independent multiplier for every labeled structure, increasing the diversity of relative contrast. Whereas prior generative enhancement uses image translation trained on unpaired real radiographs of the target anatomy [ 25 ] , we apply a pretrained, general-purpose image editor [ 26 ] with no X-ray-specific training. Beyond these methodological differences, prior evaluations on real X-rays have been confined to one or two body regions, chiefly the chest [ 29 , 32 , 31 ] and pelvis [ 25 ] . To our knowledge, FleXray is the first automatic model evaluated and performant on real X-rays across the body, spanning eight held-out datasets of the limbs, pelvis, spine, and chest.
blocks.zh: 先前的基于减少灾害风险的分解方法采用单一的投影模型,或者平行的[29],或者圆锥束[32,31],而据我们所知,在培训前提供的一组有限的减少灾害风险上进行训练。 FleXray将离线生成的DRR与在线渲染结合,在培训期间,其投影模型和获取参数各不相同. 我们的衰减随机化也与AnyCXR[32]不同,AnyCXR在软组织结构上共享缩放系数,独立扰动的只有单个的脊椎和肋骨. 相反,我们为每个标注的结构绘制了独立的乘数,增加了相对对比的多样性。 先前的基因增强使用在目标解剖学的未发光真放射图上训练的图像翻译[25],而我们则使用经过预训的通用图像编辑器[26],没有X射线专用训练. 除了这些方法上的差异外,以前对真X光的评价仅限于一两个身体区域,主要是胸部[29、32、31]和盆腔[25]。 据我们所知,FleXray是第一个在真X射线上对身体进行评估和表演的自动模型,横跨了肢体、骨盆、脊椎和胸部的8个固定数据集。

blocks.en: As X-rays were hard to annotate before the development of our model, our evaluation is limited by a low number of evaluation datasets with available ground truth. For example, none of our quantitative experiments include X-ray datasets with substantial clinical text overlays, despite their prevalence in real X-rays. Further, the data engine inherits biases from its CT sources, which image predominantly adults in supine poses with extremities out of the field-of-view. Targeted real X-rays partly compensate for these gaps, but FleXray can still fail on unseen acquisition geometries. Importantly, pathologies, implants, and surgical hardware are also not explicitly synthesized beyond those that are already present in the source CTs, leading to failures on severe trauma and other strongly out-of-distribution cases ( Figure 12 ). These limitations suggest a direct path forward: remaining coverage gaps can be addressed with targeted real or synthesized examples, while our finetuning experiments show that FleXray can adapt to new pathological targets using relatively few labeled radiographs.
blocks.zh: 由于在开发我们的模型之前,X射线很难进行注释,因此我们的评价受到具有地面真相的评价数据集数量很少的限制。 例如,我们的定量实验中没有一个包括具有大量临床文本覆盖的X射线数据集,尽管它们在真正的X射线中普遍存在. 此外,数据引擎还继承了其CT来源的偏差,而这种偏差主要表现为成人在苏宾语中呈现出场外的极端形象。 定向真X射线部分弥补了这些缺口,但FleXray仍然可以失败于隐形收购几何. 重要的是,病理、植入物和外科硬件的合成也不明显超出来源CT中已经存在的范围,导致严重创伤和其他强烈的分散性病例的失败(图12)。 这些局限表明有一条直接的前进道路:剩下的覆盖差距可以用有针对性的真实或综合的例子来解决,而我们的微调实验表明,FleXray可以使用相对较少的标签放射图来适应新的病理目标.

blocks.en: FleXray demonstrates that broad X-ray segmentation can be learned largely from synthetic supervision when the training distribution is designed to cover the variation encountered in real radiographs. More importantly, the resulting predictions make routine X-rays amenable to quantitative measurement, downstream optimization, and data-efficient learning. Together with the released models, data engine, and dataset, this creates a foundation for the quantitative analysis of X-rays in clinical research, analogous to the advances enabled by general-purpose segmentation tools in CT and MRI [ 1 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: FleXray表明,在设计培训分布以涵盖真实射电图中遇到的变异时,可以主要从合成监督中了解广泛的X射线分解. 更重要的是,由此产生的预测使得常规的X射线适合于定量测量、下游优化和数据高效学习。 与释放的模型、数据引擎和数据集一起,这为临床研究中的X射线定量分析打下了基础,类似于CT和核磁共振[1、6]中普通用途分解工具所促成的进展。

blocks.en:
DRRs can differ substantially in appearance from clinical X-rays [ 25 ] . To reduce this domain shift, we further generate a dataset of enhanced DRRs by applying a pretrained text-conditioned image editing diffusion model. We apply flux.2-klein-9b [ 26 ] ( Flux ) to

blocks.en: The real X-ray datasets supplement CT-derived supervision with peripheral bone anatomy that is poorly represented in available CT datasets: HandBones, which covers diverse hand segmentations; FootBones, which has annotations for toes and metatarsals; and the MURA forearm and humerus subsets, which we annotated ourselves ( Section K.2 ). blocks.en: FleXray segments 60 structures: the skull, sternum, sacrum, and hip bones; the scapulae, clavicles, humeri, radii, ulnae, carpals, metacarpals, and hand phalanges; the femurs, patellae, tibiae, fibulae, tarsals, metatarsals, and toes; each rib pair individually (ribs 1–12); each vertebra individually (C1 – C7, T1 – T12, L1 – L5); and the lungs, heart, liver, kidneys, and spleen. Bilateral structures share one channel (e.g., the left and right femur are both “femurs”).

blocks.en: For CT datasets, we divided each volume into overlapping 512 × \times 512 × \times 256 crops to reduce disk-to-RAM transfer costs during data-loading for online DRR rendering. For each crop, we padded with HU intensities corresponding to air if the crop z < z<{} 256 and limited crop-overlap to 50%. Each crop stores the CT, label map, affine matrix, and foreground centroids used to sample randomized DRR views during training ( Table 2 ). For MOOSE, HaN-Seg, and Shoulder-CT, we ran the MOOSE-Z automated CT segmentation pipeline [ 77 ] to segment the volumes. For RSNAFrac, we ran TotalSegmentator [ 1 ] to add a skull label. For PedsCT, we took the raw RTSTRUCT contours and converted them into voxel masks. Finally, for ElbowCT, we took the original label STL surface meshes and transformed them into the CT coordinate frame, sampled and voxelized, and filled them into solid masks.

blocks.en: B.1 Network architecture
blocks.zh: B.1 网络架构

blocks.en: FleXray is an ensemble of five networks (members) that share one architecture and differ only in their training-data mixture. Each member is a seven-level 2D convolutional U-Net [ 78 ] , with its encoder and decoder using the same feature widths at matched resolutions, 64, 128, 256, 512, 512, 720, and 1024. Each encoder block is composed of three 3 × \times 3 convolutions, each followed by a LeakyReLU activation and instance normalization. A residual connection is used around the convolutional layer, using an identity mapping when the input and output widths match, and a 1 × \times 1 convolution with normalization to match feature widths otherwise. A final 1 × \times 1 convolution maps the decoder features to per-channel logits with per-channel sigmoid activations used to map the logits to independent, overlapping probability maps. We also considered using a pretrained segmentation foundation model for fine-tuning with our data recipe, but did not observe a clear accuracy advantage ( Section E.2.2 ).
blocks.zh: FleXray是一个由五个网络(成员)组成的集合体,它们共享一个架构,仅在培训-数据混合方面有所不同. 每个成员都是一个7级2D分解的U-Net [78],其编码和解码器在相匹配的分辨率下使用相同的特性宽度,分别为64,128,256,512,512,720和1024. 每一个编码器块由三个3×x\times 3的分解组成,每个分解后再进行LeakyReLU活化和实例正常化. 余接被用在了相旋地层周围,在输入和输出宽度相匹配时使用身份映射,而1×\times 1与正态相接以匹配特征宽度,否则. 最终的 1 ×\times 1 编解码器特性映射到每个通道的日志,并带有用于将日志映射到独立,相重叠概率图的每个通道 sigmoid活化. 我们还考虑使用经过预先训练的分解基础模型来微调我们的数据配方,但没有看到明显的准确性优势(E.2.2.节)。

blocks.en: MOOSE-derived data fills a fixed 75% of the sampling budget in every member; the supplemental CT and real X-ray sources fill the remaining 25% at the weights of Table 1 . The members differ only in how this 75% is divided between DRRs rendered online during training and the offline enhanced DRRs: the offline enhanced DRRs take 0, 1/3, 1/2, 2/3, or all of the MOOSE budget, with online rendering taking the rest. We found that combining online and offline rendering yields higher mean Dice than using either alone ( Section E.2.1 ).

blocks.en: X-ray segmentation evaluation is challenging due to the scarcity of diverse segmentation datasets available online. We made a best-effort attempt to gather a diverse selection of eight X-ray segmentation datasets that cover a broad range of target anatomy and acquisition settings ( Table 4 ). These collectively cover the trunk and both limbs, spanning lungs (DarwinCVD19), ribs (VinDr-Rib), spine (PedsTorso, DeepFluoro), pelvis and hip (HipRay, DeepFluoro), femur, tibia, and fibula (LowerLimbs), upper limbs (ElbowLat), and the carpals, metacarpals, and forearm bones of the hand and wrist (RAM-W600). They span standard and oblique radiography and intra-operative fluoroscopy (DeepFluoro), frontal and lateral acquisitions (ElbowLat), and both adult and pediatric anatomy (PedsTorso).
blocks.zh: X射线分解评价具有挑战性,因为缺乏在线提供的多种分解数据集。 我们尽力收集8个X射线分解数据集,这些数据集涵盖广泛的目标解剖和获取设置(表4)。 它们共同覆盖了树干和两肢,横贯肺部(DarwinCVD19)、肋骨(VinDr-Rib)、脊椎(PedsTorso、DeepFluoro)、骨盆和臀部(HipRay、DeepFluoro)、股骨、tibia和纤维(下林布斯)、上肢(ElbowLat)、以及手和腕的前骨(RAM-W600)。 它们跨越了标准的和偏斜的射线学和操作内氟校正(DeepFluoro),前取和后取(ElbowLat),以及成人和儿科解剖学(PedsTorso).

blocks.en: In five of the eight sets, the evaluation masks retain spatial overlap, so one pixel can carry several labels (Mask type in Table 4 ). FleXray and the generalist baselines each emit a separate mask per structure, and the dataset-specific nnU-Nets are trained in region-based mode on these five datasets ( Section C.4 ), so no method is restricted to a mutually exclusive partition when scoring them.
blocks.zh: 在8套中的5套中,评价口罩保留了空间重叠,因此一像素可以携带多个标签(表4中的面具类型). FleXray和通论基线各发出每个结构的单独遮罩,数据集特有的nnU-Net则在这五个数据集(C.4节)上进行区域模式培训,因此在打分时没有方法限制于相互排斥的分区.

blocks.en: All of the main reported results, and the ablations, are scored on the test partitions, which were held out during model development. The validation partitions were used only for development decisions, such as choosing the FleXray (single) network for the ablations and finetuning ( Table 8 ). The pretrained FleXray members and every ablation model are evaluated at their final training epoch without checkpoint selection ( Section B.2 ). All evaluation annotations were sourced from publicly released datasets and annotation projects.
blocks.zh: 所有主要报告结果和活塞在测试分区上都得分,这些分区是在模型开发期间举行的。 验证分区只用于开发决定,例如选择FleXray(单)网络来进行调试和微调(表8.). FleXray训练有素的成员和每个禁忌模式在他们最后的训练时期没有选择检查站时进行评价(B.2节)。 所有评价说明都取自公开发布的数据集和注释项目。

blocks.en: Quality control and splits. The per-image split assignment of every source, together with each excluded image and its reason, is released with the dataset ( https://huggingface.co/datasets/VictorButoi/flexray-data ). For sources we cannot redistribute, the lists are keyed by the original filenames. Before assigning splits, we removed exact-duplicate images, which would otherwise place the same radiograph in several partitions, and images whose annotation contained no foreground after mapping into our label protocol. These affected DarwinCVD19 (33 duplicates, 108 empty masks, and 16 annotations whose image is absent from the public download) and ElbowLat (11 empty masks). We additionally excluded a small number of individual images whose annotations we judged unreliable on manual review: one in HipRay, five in LowerLimbs, four DeepFluoro frames with questionable ground-truth poses reported upstream, one AASCE radiograph whose landmarks fall outside the image, and three MTDDH images with a corrupt file or an out-of-bounds polygon. No other evaluation dataset had exclusions. All criteria were fixed before any model was scored and apply identically to FleXray and every baseline.

blocks.en: C.1 Protocol post-processing
blocks.zh: C.1 礼宾后处理

blocks.en: In order to compare our predictions, and those of our baselines, to the held-out X-ray ground-truth labels, we apply minimal deterministic post-processing to all predictions to align them with our evaluation sets. Each adjustment is applied identically to every method. All rules were derived from each dataset’s annotation documentation and inspection of its training-split annotations, fixed before scoring the evaluation partitions, and were not tuned on their performance.
blocks.zh: 为了把我们的预测和基线的预测与所持有的X射线地面实况标签相提并论,我们对所有的预测进行最低限度的确定后处理,使之与我们的评价组合保持一致。 每项调整均对每种方法同样适用。 所有规则均取自每一数据集的说明文件并检查其培训-分解说明,在评分分之前固定,而不调整其性能。

blocks.en: For quantitative evaluation on lung datasets (DarwinCVD19 and PedsTorso), we set lung probabilities to zero where there is predicted liver or spleen to restrict the predictions to visible contours of the lungs. For DeepFluoro lumbar-spine and PedsTorso thoracolumbar-spine, we take the pixelwise maximum in probability space over the corresponding vertebra channels (L1–L5, and T1–T12 together with L1–L5, respectively). For PedsTorso and HipRay, we collapse both the prediction and the reference into a single mutually exclusive overlay under a fixed per-dataset priority order (thoracolumbar spine over lungs for PedsTorso, femurs over hips for HipRay).
blocks.zh: 为了对肺数据集进行定量评价(DarwinCVD19和PedsTorso),我们将肺概率设定为有预测肝脏或脾脏的地方为零,以将预测限制在肺的可见轮廓上. 对于DeepFluoro lumbar-spine和PedsTorso Thoracolumbar-spine,我们在相应的顶点通道(分别为L1-L5和T1-T12并列L1-L5)上,将概率空间的像素化为最大. 对PedsTorso和HipRay来说,我们崩溃了预测和参照,在一个固定的每个数据集优先级顺序(PedsTorso的胸骨压在肺上,HipRay的股骨压在臀部上)。

blocks.en: We evaluate segmentation overlap quality with both the Dice similarity coefficient [ 91 ] , which measures the spatial overlap between a ground-truth mask and a predicted mask, and 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) [ 92 ] , which measures boundary error in pixels. For every boundary pixel of one mask we take the Euclidean distance to the nearest boundary pixel of the other, and HD95 is the larger of the two directed 95th percentiles; boundaries are each mask minus its one-pixel erosion. A structure present in the ground truth but absent from the thresholded prediction is excluded from that image’s HD95 average. Dice and HD95 are computed per structure and averaged per image. A structure whose ground truth occupies less than 0.1% of the image area is dropped from that image, so that vanishingly small structures do not contribute to its score.
blocks.zh: 我们评价分化质量与Dice相似性系数[91],该系数测量地面真面罩和预测口罩之间的空间重叠,以及第95-百分率的Husdorff距离(HD95)[92],该系数测量像素中的边界误差。 对于一个口罩的每一个边界像素,我们把欧克利德的相距取到另一个最近的边界像素,HD95是两个直径95百分位数中较大的;边界是每个口罩减去其一像素侵蚀. 地面真象中存在但未包含在阈值预测中的结构被排除在该图像的HD95平均值之外。 谷分和HD95按结构计算,并按图像平均计算。 一个占地真象面积不到图像面积0.1%的结构被从图像中掉出,这样消失的细小结构就无助于它的分数.

blocks.en: We compare against general-purpose X-ray segmentation methods that, like FleXray, did not train on the held-out real X-ray evaluation sets. As a reference, we also trained a set of dataset-specific nnU-Net models on each of the X-ray evaluation segmentation datasets. We evaluated only labels represented by a method’s released output vocabulary. For our baselines, we applied the TTA scheme that they considered as part of their method (no TTA if they did not use it). Table 7 summarizes their computational footprints, and Table 6 reports the full per-dataset comparison (both in Section E.1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们比较了通用的X射线分解方法,这些方法与FleXray一样,没有在被搁置的真X射线评价装置上进行训练. 作为参考,我们还在X射线评价分块数据集上培训了一套数据集特有的nnU-Net模型. 我们只评价了一种方法释放的输出词汇所代表的标签。 就我们的基线而言,我们采用了他们认为是其方法的一部分的TTA计划(如果不使用则没有TTA)。 表7总结了它们的计算足迹,表6报告了每个数据集的全面比较(均载于E.1节)。

blocks.en: We used the authors’ ResNet50-UNet pretrained checkpoint which predicts 159 output channels. Each X-ray was replicated to three channels, normalized with ImageNet statistics, and resized to 512 × \times 512 to match their training.
blocks.zh: 我们使用作者的ResNet50-UNet预先训练的检查站, 每道X光被复制到三个频道,与ImageNet统计正常化,并调整为512×\times 512,以配合他们的训练.

blocks.en: We used the released ensemble of models for cardiac, muscle, organ, rib, and vertebral groups, yielding 117 native foreground channels. Images were processed with the nnU-Net plans and preprocessing stored with the released models. For DeepFluoro only, we inverted each image’s intensities within its per-image dynamic range before applying the TotalSegmentator2D preprocessing. Inference uses nnU-Net’s default flip-mirroring test-time augmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们用释放出来的模型组合 用于心脏、肌肉、器官、肋骨和脊椎组, 产生117个本土前缘通道。 图像与nnU-Net计划一起处理,预处理则与发布模型一起储存. 仅DeepFluoro而言,我们在应用TotalSecmentator2D预处理之前,将每个图像的强度反转到其每幅图像动态范围内. 推论使用 nnU-Net 默认的翻转迷你测试时间增强.

blocks.en: FluoroSAM differs from other baselines and FleXray as it is an interactive-segmentation method. We used the released Swin-L checkpoint at its 448 × \times 448 training resolution. Prompt names were derived from the foreground labels in our shared protocol. For each scored non-bilateral label, we supplied its text prompt and one positive point at the center of each connected ground-truth component. For bilateral structures, we issued separate left- and right-specific text prompts with one positive ground-truth-derived point per available side and combined the two score maps by pixelwise maximum.
blocks.zh: FluorosAM与其他基线和FleXray不同,因为它是一种交互分块法. 我们使用释放的Swin-L检查站 在它的448x\时间448培训决议。 从我们共享协议中的前台标签中 衍生出快速名称 对于每个打出的非双边标签,我们提供了其文本即时和每个连接的地面实况部分中心的一个正点。 对于双边结构,我们发布了单独的左向和右向特定文字提示,每个可用侧各有一个正向地真相取出点,并用像素最大值将两个分数图合并.

blocks.en: We time per-image model execution at batch size 1 in FP32 on an NVIDIA V100 at each method’s native input resolution: 256 × \times 256 for FleXray and for each of the five TotalSegmentator2D anatomy-group models, 512 × \times 512 for PAXray, and 448 × \times 448 for FluoroSAM. Input preparation and dataset-specific postprocessing are outside the timer. Ensemble timings include prediction averaging, and TTA timings additionally include augmentation, normalization, inverse alignment, and averaging across views. We select one test image from each of the eight primary segmentation evaluation datasets in Table 4 . For each image, latency is the mean of 10 CUDA-synchronized runs after 5 warmup runs, and memory is the peak allocation during a post-warmup run. We report mean latency across the eight images with an image-level bootstrap confidence interval. FluoroSAM’s timing covers one image-encoder pass followed by 62 text-prompt encoder and mask-decoder passes, covering the 60 protocol structures plus lumbar spine and thoracolumbar spine, without point prompts.
blocks.zh: 我们在FP32的分批尺寸1上按NVIDIA V100按每种方法的原生输入分辨率进行每幅图像模型执行的时间:FleXray的256x\times 256和TotalSegmentator2D解剖组模型的每个,PAXray的512x\times 512,FluorosAM的448x\times 448。 输入准备和数据集特定的后处理在定时器外. 集合的时间包括预测平均,而TTA的时间还包括增强、正常化、逆向调整和各种观点的平均值。 我们从表4的八个主要分区评价数据集中各选取一个测试图像。 对于每个图像,耐用是10个CUDA同步运行在5个热量运行后的平均值,而内存则是后热量运行期间的峰值分配. 我们报告说,这八幅图像的间隔很长, 具有图像级的靴子置信间隔。 FluoroSAM的授时范围包括一个图像编码器通过,然后是62个文本即时编码器和口罩解码器通过,覆盖60个协议结构外加腰椎和胸椎,没有点提示.

blocks.en: We trained independent nnU-Net [ 69 ] networks for each evaluation dataset in Table 4 . We use nnU-Net’s default configuration and 1,000-epoch schedule, without dataset-specific hyperparameter tuning or fold ensembling. Where annotated structures overlap (Mask type in Table 4 ), we train nnU-Net in its region-based mode. Mutually exclusive datasets use the standard softmax configuration. Inference uses nnU-Net’s default flip-mirroring test-time augmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们为表4中的每个评价数据集培训了独立的nU-Net[69]网络。 我们使用 nnU-Net 的默认配置和 1000 个时段表, 不使用特定数据集的超参数调取或折叠的 综艺 。 在附加说明的结构重叠的地方(表4中的任务类型),我们按区域模式培训nnU-Net。 相互排斥的数据集使用标准软max配置. 推论使用 nnU-Net 默认的翻转迷你测试时间增强.

blocks.en: D.1 Cobb-angle estimation
blocks.zh: D.1 Cobb-angle 估计

blocks.en: AASCE is partitioned by patient into a validation split (262 images; 39, 107, and 116 low, moderate, and severe curves) and a test split (218 images; 33, 100, and 85).
blocks.zh: AASCE被患者分为验证分(262个图像;39个,107个和116个低度,中度和重度曲线)和测试分(218个图像;33个,100个和85个).

blocks.en: We apply the same procedure with identical settings to FleXray and every baseline. We threshold the prediction channels for T1–T12 and L1–L5, the 17 vertebrae annotated in AASCE, at 0.5, assigning overlapping pixels to the more superior vertebra. For each vertebra, we retain the largest connected component and discard it if its area is below 0.1% of the image. We order the surviving vertebrae superior to inferior by mask centroid. Images with fewer than three surviving vertebrae are excluded from that method’s error statistics and counted toward its failure rate.
blocks.zh: 我们对FleXray和每个基线都采用相同的设置。 我们把T1–T12和L1–L5的预测通道,即AASCE注解的17个顶点,设定为0.5,将相重叠的像素分配给较高级的顶点. 对于每个椎骨,我们保留最大的连接组件,如果其面积低于图像的0.1%。 我们命令幸存的脊椎 优于下等的口罩心肌 不到三个幸存脊椎的图像被排除在该方法的错误统计之外,并计入其故障率。

blocks.en: Following Pan et al. [ 96 ] , we approximate vertebral end-plate orientations from the spinal centerline connecting consecutive mask centroids. For each interior vertebra, the end-plate direction is the axial bisector of the normals to its two adjacent centerline segments, treating the normals as undirected lines. The first and last end-plate directions are horizontal. We represent these directions by unit vectors pointing toward image right and report their largest pairwise angular separation as the predicted major Cobb angle, following the challenge’s reference procedure [ 51 ] . The reference major angle is the maximum of the three provided AASCE angles.

blocks.en: DeepFluoro [ 45 ] provides ground-truth camera poses and 3D fiducial landmarks for six cadaver specimens. We evaluate on the 213 frames of the two held-out test specimens ( Table 4 ). Each frame is registered from two initializations: a coarse, clinically practical pose constructed from anatomical landmarks (Method 1 in Grupp et al. [45] ), and the pose predicted by the whole-body foundation pose-regression model of xvr [ 46 ] , which is not trained on DeepFluoro. Because a single radiograph does not disambiguate the anterior–posterior orientation, the foundation initialization is run in both orientations and the result with the lower final objective ( Equation 10 ) is kept for each method, so the two methods can start from different orientations of the same frame and their initial errors differ slightly (76.6 versus 76.1 mm median).

The Chamfer terms raise this to about 9 seconds from the foundation initialization and 28 seconds from the coarse initialization, whose strong weights keep the optimizer from stopping early.

blocks.en: D.3 Data-efficient finetuning
blocks.zh: D.3 数据效率微调

blocks.en: All fine-tuned networks are initialized from the final checkpoint of FleXray (single). We replace the final 1 × \times 1 output convolution with a randomly initialized head sized to the target protocol, and fine-tune end-to-end.
blocks.zh: 所有微调的网络都从FleXray(单一)的最终检查站初始化. 我们把最终的1×\times 1输出会变换成随机初始化头大小到目标协议,并微调端到端.

blocks.en: Each run trains for 250 epochs of 50 iterations at a batch size of 16 and 256 × \times 256 resolution. We use AdamW with a peak learning rate of 3 × \times 10 -4 , weight decay 3 × \times 10 -5 , a 5-epoch linear warm-up from 0.1 × \times the peak, and cosine decay thereafter, in 32-bit precision and without EMA. We use the same objective as FleXray pre-training ( Section B.2 ). For every run we keep the checkpoint with the highest mean foreground Dice on the validation split and report on the test split. To ensure a fair comparison, during training we apply the default 2D augmentation pipeline of nnU-Net v2 [ 69 ] (rotation, scaling, Gaussian noise and blur, brightness, contrast, simulated low resolution, and gamma), restricting rotation to ± \pm 15 ∘ and using the same left–right flip as TTA.
blocks.zh: 每节列车运行时间为250个世纪,50个迭代,分批规模为16个和256个x\times 256个分辨率. 我们使用 AdamW 的峰值学习率为 3 ×\times 10 -4, 重量衰减 3 ×\times 10 -5, 从 0.1 ×\times 峰值的 5 个时段线性暖和, 之后的 余弦衰减, 精确度为 32 位, 没有 EMA 。 我们使用与FleXray预训相同的目标(B.2节)。 每跑一次,我们保留检查点 最高的平面前端 验证分,并报告测试分。 为确保公平比较,在训练中,我们应用了nnU-Net v2 [69] (旋转、缩放、高斯噪音和模糊、亮度、对比、模拟低分辨率和伽马)的默认2D扩能管道,将自转限制在±\pm 15 QQ,并使用与TTA相同的左-右翻.

blocks.en: For few-shot configurations, we draw subsets from the training split of each dataset ( Table 4 ). Within a repeat, every smaller subset is a prefix of the larger ones. Budgets below 100% use three repeats drawn with different seeds. FleXray and the from-scratch nnU-Net comparators ( Section C.4 ) read the identical subset manifests, validate on the same validation split, and are scored on the same test split.
blocks.zh: 对于几发配置,我们从每个数据集的训练分拆中抽取子集(表4). 在重复中,每个更小的子集都是较大子集的前缀. 低于100%的预算使用用不同种子抽取的三次重复. FleXray和从scratch nnU-Net的比较器(C.4节)读取相同的子集表,在同一验证分数上验证,在同一测试分数上被打分.

blocks.en: The head has five channels: background, ilium, pubis, ischium, and femoral head. The femoral head overlaps the acetabular bones, so MTDDH is an overlapping dataset ( Table 4 ) and its nnU-Net comparator is trained in region-based mode on the same four foreground labels. The dataset’s native femur annotation is mapped to background for both FleXray and nnU-Net because FleXray already segments the femur. Subsets are selected at the patient level by a seeded random permutation, at 1%, 5%, 10%, 50%, and 100% of the training split (6, 32, 63, 316, and 632 patients).
blocks.zh: 头部有五个渠道:背景,ilium,pubis,ischium,和femoral头. 股骨头与表骨相重叠,所以MTDDH是一个相重叠的数据集(表4),其nnU-Net参照器在相同的四个前缘标签上以区域模式训练. FleXray 和 nnU-Net 由于 FleXray 已经分出股骨, 子集在患者一级通过种子随机穿插选择,分出1%,5%,10%,50%,100%的训练(6,32,63,316和632个患者).

blocks.en: The head has two channels, background and tumor, and all images carry a tumor. Subsets cover 1%, 5%, 10%, 50%, and 100% of the training split (13, 65, 130–131, 653, and 1,305 images). Because BTXRD spans three centers and nine diagnosis categories with skewed frequencies, subsets are stratified rather than drawn uniformly. Cases are added in an order that preserves the full split’s center and diagnosis proportions at every budget.
blocks.zh: 头部有两个通道,背景和肿瘤,所有图像都带有肿瘤. 子集覆盖1%,5%,10%,50%,100%的培训分成(13,65,130–131,653和1,305个图像). 由于BTXRD跨越了三个中心和9个诊断类别,频率扭曲,子集被分层分出,而不是被统一地抽取. 增加病例的顺序保持了每个预算的完全中心与诊断比例。

blocks.en: BTXRD is scored by detection AP50 ( Section C.2 ), the endpoint reported by the dataset’s authors [ 71 ] . Ground truth is the expert’s bounding rectangle for each of the 354 tumors in the test split, transformed with the same padding and resizing as the image. Both FleXray and nnU-Net are scored on softmax probabilities averaged over the image and its horizontal reflection. AP50 is computed per network and averaged over training repeats. Tumor-size quartiles are fixed once on the training split by box area as a fraction of the padded image; following the COCO convention, unmatched candidates outside a quartile’s size range are ignored rather than counted as false positives. Because every BTXRD radiograph contains a tumor, precision is measured on tumor-positive images only and does not estimate specificity on normal radiographs.
blocks.zh: BTXRD通过探测AP50(C.2节)得分,这是数据集作者报告的终点[71]. 地面真理是专家在试验分出354个肿瘤时的相接矩形,这些肿瘤的变形与图像相同并重新大小。 FleXray和nnU-Net都根据图像及其水平反射平均的软马克思概率得到分数。 AP50按每个网络计算,在重复培训时平均计算。 肿瘤大小的四分位被固定在训练上一次,按箱区划分,作为加成图像的一小部分;在COCO公约之后,四分位大小范围以外的无匹配候选人被忽略,而不是被算作虚假阳性. 由于每个BTXRD射电图中都包含有肿瘤,精确度只用肿瘤阳性图像来测量,并不估计正常射电图上的特异性.

blocks.en: E.1 Full quantitative quality comparison against baselines
blocks.zh: E.1 联合国 与基线的全面定量质量比较

blocks.en: Table 6 gives the per-dataset results behind Figure 3 . On the wrist, elbow, and lower-limb datasets, FluoroSAM is the only released generalist with sufficient label coverage, and FleXray exceeds it by 0.42–0.71 Dice even though FluoroSAM receives a ground-truth-derived text prompt and click for every structure ( Section C.4 ). On the hip and on fluoroscopy, TotalSegmentator2D covers the labels but reaches only 0.478 and 0.371, the latter after per-image intensity inversion (0.026 if using the native polarity for DeepFluoro). The margins are smallest on adult chest radiographs, the domain both chest generalists target. On VinDr-Rib, PAXray is numerically higher but not significantly different from FleXray (0.751 vs. 0.737; n = = 37 images; p = = 0.146). On PedsTorso, FleXray significantly exceeds TotalSegmentator2D (0.831 vs. 0.719; n = = 12; p = = 0.031). On DarwinCVD19, FleXray leads TotalSegmentator2D by 0.018 Dice (0.924 vs. 0.906; n = = 952; p < < 0.001).
blocks.zh: 表6列出了图3后面的每个数据集结果。 在手腕,肘部和下行尺数据集上,FluorosAM是唯一被释放的具有足够标签覆盖度的通论者,而FleXray超过了它0.42–0.71. 尽管FluorosAM收到一个地面真实的文本,但每个结构都立即点击(C.4节)。 在臀部和氟镜上,TotalSegmentator2D覆盖了标签,但只达到0.478和0.371,后者在平面图像强度倒置后(如果为DeepFluoro使用本土极性,则为0.026). 在成人胸腔放射图上边距最小,域名是两个胸腔通论者的目标. 在VinDr-Rib上,PAXray的数值较高,但与FleXray(0.751 vs. 0.737;n = = 37个图像;p = = 0.146)没有显著区别. 在PedsTorso上,FleXray显著地超过了TotalSegmentator2D(0.831对0.719;n==12;p===0.031). 在达尔文CVD19上,FleXray带领TotalSegmentator2D以0.018 Dice(0.924对0.906;n==952;p < 0.001).

blocks.en: The in-domain nnU-Nets exceed FleXray on seven datasets by 0.03–0.09 Dice. The exception is DeepFluoro, where the nnU-Net trained on the 70 frames of two subjects reaches 0.866 on the two held-out subjects, against 0.915 for FleXray ( n = = 213; p < < 0.001).
blocks.zh: 域内nU-Net在7个数据集上超过了FleXray以0.03–0.09 Dice. 例外是DeepFluoro,在DeepFluoro,NNU-Net就两个课题的70个框架进行了培训,在两个被搁置课题上达到了0.866,而FleXray(n==213;p < 0.001)则达到了0.915。

blocks.en: The four FleXray configurations separate the contributions of ensembling and test-time augmentation. Averaging the five members raises the equal-dataset mean Dice from 0.866 to 0.874; 16-sample TTA adds a further 0.004 to FleXray (single) and 0.001 to the ensemble. These gains come at the cost of additional computation ( Table 7 ). FleXray (single) is of the same order as PAXray in size and latency (101.4M vs. 73.4M parameters; 14.7 vs. 15.5 ms per image), TotalSegmentator2D accumulates 167.5M parameters and 23.8 ms across its five anatomy-group models, and FluoroSAM (268.7M parameters) needs 623.7 ms for 62 text prompts, a cost that grows with the number of structures queried. The released ensemble uses five times as many parameters (507.0M) and takes 74.2 ms per image; TTA increases its latency to 1.24 s, while peaking at 2.36 GB of GPU memory. FleXray (single) without TTA therefore retains 99% of the released configuration’s accuracy at approximately 1/84 of its latency.
blocks.zh: 四个FleXray配置将综艺和测试时间增强的贡献分开. 对五个成员进行对比,将等分数据集平均值Dice从0.866提高到0.874;16-样本TTA在FleXray(单曲)和001在综艺节目中又增加了0.04. 这些收益是以额外计算成本为代价的(表7)。 FleXray(单)在大小和耐用度上与PAXray(101.4M对73.4M参数;14.7对15.5ms每幅图像),TotalSigmentator2D在它的5个解剖组模型上累积了167.5M参数和23.8ms,而FluorosAM(268.7M参数)需要62个文本提示623.7ms,这一成本随着被询问的结构数量而增加. 所发行的综艺节目使用参数为5倍(507.0M)并每张图像需要74.2 ms;TTA将它的耐久性提升到1.24 s,而最高峰是GPU内存的2.36 GB. 因此,没有TTA的FleXray(单)保留了释放配置的99%的准确度,约为其延迟的1/84。

blocks.en: E.2 Ablations
blocks.zh: E.2 拖欠款项

blocks.en: We trained several different versions of the FleXray (single) network to evaluate different parts of our training pipeline. The ablations reuse the FleXray training recipe ( Appendix B ) except for the components under study and the SAM2-specific input resolutions and optimization settings described in Section E.2.2 . All ablation models are evaluated on the test partitions of the held-out real-X-ray suite ( Table 4 ) with the same 16-sample test-time augmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们培训了几个不同版本的FleXray(单一)网络,以评估我们培训管道的不同部分。 除了E.2.2节所描述的正在研究的组件和SAM2-特定输入分辨率和优化设置之外,再利用FleXray培训配方(附录B)。 所有膨胀模型均在16个样本测试时间相同的被搁置的真-X射线套件(表4)的测试分区上进行评估.

blocks.en: E.2.1 Mixing online and offline rendering performs best
blocks.zh: 经济及社会理事会 在线和离线渲染效果最好

blocks.en: FleXray draws its MOOSE-derived supervision from two streams: DRRs rendered online during training ( Section A.1 ) and the offline enhanced DRRs dataset ( Section A.2 ). We trained five networks that hold the combined budget at 75% (all other streams at the weights of Table 1 ) while sweeping the online/offline split: 75/0, 50/25, 37.5/37.5, 25/50, and 0/75.
blocks.zh: FleXray从两个流派中抽取其MOOSE产生的监督: 培训期间在线提供的减少灾害风险(A.1节)和离线增强的减少灾害风险数据集(A.2节)。 我们培训了五个网络,将合并预算维持在75%(所有其他流程按表1的权重计算),同时将在线/离线分拆:75/0、50/25、37.5/37.5、25/50和0/75。

blocks.en: The three mixed splits performed about the same (equal-dataset mean Dice 0.870–0.874; Table 8 ), and both extremes were worse. Online rendering alone (75/0) reached 0.858 and dropped to 0.705 on LowerLimbs: online DRRs are rendered from 512 × \times 512 × \times 256 CT crops ( Section A.6 ) and therefore cannot simulate the far, whole-limb views in that dataset. Offline rendering alone (0/75) reached an equal-dataset mean Dice of 0.852 and was lowest on four of the eight datasets, consistent with overfitting to the fixed offline renders. Because of this, we chose the balanced 37.5/37.5 split as the representative FleXray (single) from its validation-partition score.
blocks.zh: 三种混合的分裂情况大致相同(平均数据集为Dice 0.870-0.874;表8),两种极端情况都更糟。 仅在线渲染(75/0)就达到0.858并降至下林姆斯上的0.705:在线 DRR从512 ×\times 512 ×\times 256 CT作物(A.6节)得到,因此无法模拟该数据集中最远全高的视图. 仅离线渲染(0/75)就达到等值数据集平均值为0.852,在8个数据集中的4个数据集中最低,这与固定离线渲染过度一致。 由于这个原因,我们选择了平衡的37.5/37.5分,作为代表FleXray(单曲)从其验证分数中分出.

blocks.en: E.2.2 Finetuned SAM2 encoders show no significant advantage over a U-Net
blocks.zh: 经济及社会理事会 微调 SAM2 编码器对 U- Net 没有显著的优势

blocks.en: To test whether the visual prior of a natural-image foundation model improves transfer to X-rays, we fully finetune SAM2 [ 98 ] image encoders in place of the FleXray U-Net. We consider all four SAM2 Hiera variants, Tiny, Small, Base+, and Large (26.9M, 34.0M, 68.7M, and 212.2M parameters), each paired with a linear segmentation head over the 60-channel label protocol. SAM2 and FleXray (single) share the complete data engine, label harmonization, augmentation pipeline, training objective, and evaluation pipeline, including the same 16-sample test-time augmentation.
blocks.zh: 为了测试自然成像基础模型的视觉前期是否改善了向X射线的传输,我们完全微调了SAM2 [98] 图像编码器来取而代之的是FleXray U-Net. 我们认为,所有四个SAM2 Hiera变体,即Tiny、Small、Base+和Lige(26.9M、34.0M、68.7M和212.2M等参数)均在60道标签协议上用一线分头相配。 SAM2和FleXray(单一)共享完整的数据引擎,标签统一,增强管道,培训目标,评价管道,包括相同的16个样本测试时间增强.

blocks.en: The SAM2 backbones are finetuned end-to-end at a reduced learning rate (3 × \times 10 -5 , versus 3 × \times 10 -4 for the segmentation head). SAM2 uses AdamW weight decay of 0.05 for both the backbone and head, compared with 0.01 for FleXray (single). Tiny, Small, and Base+ use 896 × \times 896 inputs and 2,000 epochs; Hiera Large uses 1024 × \times 1024 inputs and 1,000 epochs, compared with 256 × \times 256 inputs and 2,000 epochs for FleXray (single). In preliminary sweeps we trained every Hiera scale at backbone learning rates of 3 × \times 10 -4 (uniform with the segmentation head), 3 × \times 10 -5 , and 10 -5 , holding the head learning rate fixed. The 10 × \times reduced backbone rate of 3 × \times 10 -5 performed best, with a ranking that was stable across encoder scales, so all final runs finetune the full, unfrozen encoder at this rate.
blocks.zh: SAM2主干线以较低的学习率进行微调(3×分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出 SAM2对骨干和头部均采用亚当W重量衰减0.05,而FleXray(单)则采用0.01. 小小一点 Small,和 Base+ 使用 896 × times 896 和 2000 个纪元; Hiera Large 使用 1024 × times 1024 和 1000 个纪元,而 FleXray ( single) 则使用 256 × times 256 和 2000 个纪元. 在初步的扫荡中,我们以3×\时分10-4分(与分头统一),3×分10-5分和10-5分的骨干学习率,对每个Hiera尺度进行了培训,将头分学习率固定下来。 10 ×\times降低主干率为 3 ×\times 10 -5 表现最好,排名稳定地跨编码器尺度,因此所有最终运行都会以这个速度微调出全,解冻的编码器.

blocks.en: Accuracy rose monotonically with encoder scale. The equal-dataset mean Dice was 0.812 [0.753, 0.857] for Hiera Tiny, 0.838 [0.781, 0.885] for Small, 0.855 [0.805, 0.896] for Base+, and 0.876 [0.829, 0.916] for Large, against 0.870 [0.817, 0.915] for FleXray (single) ( n = = 1,458 test images across the eight held-out datasets; Figure 10 ). On the same images, Tiny and Small trailed FleXray (single) by 0.058 [0.023, 0.098] and 0.031 [0.008, 0.056] Dice, whereas Base+ trailed it by 0.014 [ − - 0.005, 0.034] and Large exceeded it by 0.006 [ − - 0.009, 0.023], intervals that both include zero (paired hierarchical bootstrap of the equal-dataset mean difference). Given our data engine, we find no statistically detectable accuracy advantage for the finetuned SAM2 encoders over a from-scratch U-Net in these experiments ( Section B.1 ).

blocks.en: E.2.3 Image-space augmentation drives transfer to real X-rays
blocks.zh: 经济及社会理事会 图像空间增强驱动器传输到真X光

blocks.en: Transfer from rendered to real X-rays depends on appearance robustness that the model can only acquire through augmentation. Our data-engine injects variation at two stages: at render time, through per-label attenuation randomization, and in image space, through the augmentation preset of Table 3 . To attribute the transfer gain between these stages, we trained four regimes that add components cumulatively: (i) a base regime with neither; (ii) attenuation randomization alone; (iii) attenuation plus intensity inversion, which we isolate because radiographs are displayed in both polarities, making inversion the single largest appearance shift in the preset; and (iv) attenuation plus the complete preset, which is FleXray (single). All other training choices are unchanged.
blocks.zh: 从渲染到真实的X光,取决于外观坚固度,而模型只能通过增强来得到. 我们的数据引擎在两个阶段注入了变化:在渲染时间,通过每个标签的减值随机化,在图像空间,通过表3的增强预设。 为了将转移增益归属于这些阶段之间,我们训练了四个系统,这些系统累计添加了组件:(一) 一个没有的基态;(二) 削弱随机化本身;(三) 减弱加强度倒置,我们隔离这些,因为放射图在两个极分中都显示,使倒置成为预设中最大的单一外观倒置;以及(四) 衰减加完整的预设,即FleXray(单). 所有其他培训选择没有改变。

blocks.en: The equal-dataset mean Dice rose from 0.353 for the base regime to 0.438 with attenuation randomization alone, to 0.650 with intensity inversion added, and to 0.870 with the complete preset ( n = = 1,458 test images across the eight held-out datasets; Figure 11 ). Per-dataset paired comparisons localize the three additions; every difference named below is significant. Attenuation randomization alone improved only the adult chest radiographs and the pelvic fluoroscopy (+0.15 Dice on DarwinCVD19 and +0.07 on DeepFluoro) and was indistinguishable from the base regime on the other six datasets. Adding inversion improved seven of the eight datasets (all but the eight-image LowerLimbs), most on the hip and pelvic views (+0.46 on HipRay and +0.39 on DeepFluoro). Only the complete preset recovered the wrist and elbow datasets, which stayed below 0.3 Dice under every partial regime (+0.90 on RAM-W600 and +0.57 on ElbowLat over the inversion regime), whereas on the rib and pediatric datasets the inversion regime already matched it. Attenuation randomization therefore contributes modestly in isolation, whereas the image-space augmentations account for most of the transfer, and no single image-space operation suffices: inversion recovers only part of the full preset’s gain, and the remainder is concentrated on the peripheral anatomy. We retain the complete preset in the released model.
blocks.zh: 等值数据集表示 剂量从基数制的0.353升至0.438,单是减值随机化,再加强度倒置后升至0.650,再加到0.870,预设完整(n = = = 1,458个测试图像,横跨8个搁置数据集;图11)。 每个数据集对等比较将这三种加法本地化;下面命名的每一种差异都是显著的. 延长随机化本身仅改进了成人胸腔放射图和盆腔含氟镜(达尔文CVD19上为+0.15分,DeepFluoro上为+0.07分),与其他6个数据集的基态无法区分. 加入倒置改进了8个数据集中的7个(除了8相下立姆布斯),大部分在臀部和盆腔视图上(HipRay上+0.46,DeepFluoro上+0.39). 只有完整的预设恢复了手腕和肘部的数据集,这些数据集在每一个部分制度下都保持在0.3分以下(RAM-W600上+0.90分,ElbowLat上+0.57分,反向制度上),而肋骨和儿科数据集上的反向制度已经与之相匹配. 因此,加速随机化在孤立中作用不大,而图像空间扩增占了转移的大部分,而且没有单一的图像空间操作就足够了:倒置只恢复了全部预设收益的一部分,其余则集中在外围解剖学上. 我们保留了发布模型中的完整预设.

blocks.en: E.2.4 Real X-rays provide training coverage for peripheral radiographs
blocks.zh: 联合国 真正的X射线为外围无线电仪提供培训覆盖

blocks.en: FleXray draws supervision from three families of sources: the MOOSE-derived streams (online and offline renders), five supplemental CT datasets, and four manually annotated real X-ray sources ( Table 1 ). We train three mixtures that divide their MOOSE-derived sampling budget equally between online rendering and offline enhanced DRRs: (i) the complete mixture (75%/21%/4% MOOSE-derived/supplemental CT/real X-ray); (ii) the mixture without real X-rays (79%/21%/0%); and (iii) the mixture without supplemental CT (96%/0%/4%). When a source family is removed, its sampling share is returned equally to the two MOOSE-derived streams, keeping the number of optimization steps fixed. We quantify each source family’s contribution by comparing the complete mixture with the corresponding omission. An additional reference is trained on online MOOSE renders alone.
blocks.zh: FleXray从三个来源获得监督:MOOSE产生的流(在线和离线),5个补充CT数据集,以及4个手动附加说明的真正X射线源(表1)。 我们培训三种混合物,将其MOOSE生成的取样预算在在线渲染和离线增强的减少灾害风险之间平分:(一) 完整的混合物(75%/21%/4 %MOOSE生成/补充CT/真X射线);(二) 没有真X射线的混合物(79%/21%/0%);(三) 没有补充CT的混合物(96%/0%/4%/4%)。 当一个源头家族被移除后,其采样份额被平等还给MOOSE出自的两个流,使优化步骤的数量固定. 我们通过将完整的混合物与相应的遗漏进行比较,量化每个来源家庭的贡献。 还有一个参考材料是在在线MOOSE中单独培训的。

blocks.en: We focus on source effects that are significant ( Section K.1 ) and at least 0.01 Dice. Under this criterion, the real X-ray sources (535 annotated training radiographs, 4% of the sampling budget) improve two datasets: RAM-W600, whose wrists are otherwise essentially unsegmented (0.004 to 0.946, n = = 124), and ElbowLat (+0.325 Dice, n = = 91; both p < < 0.001; Table 9 ). Including real X-rays raises the equal-dataset mean Dice from 0.712 to 0.870. The supplemental CT datasets (503 annotated training subjects, 21% of the budget) provide an additional gain on ElbowLat (+0.024 Dice, n = = 91, p < < 0.001). No other dataset meets both criteria in either comparison. These comparisons show the importance of real X-ray annotations for the wrist and elbow datasets, with supplemental CT providing a smaller additional benefit on the elbow. The held-out suite does not evaluate the skull and shoulder anatomy targeted by some supplemental CT sources, so this ablation does not measure their contribution to those regions.

blocks.en: K.1 Statistics and reproducibility
blocks.zh: K.1 统计和可复制性

blocks.en: Unless stated otherwise, results are means with 95% percentile-bootstrap confidence intervals from 10,000 resamples. Per-dataset estimates resample images; equal-dataset summaries resample datasets and then images. Task-specific analyses resample inference seeds (TTA), cases (BTXRD), or matched label–frame observations (view-angle analyses). MTDDH repeats are averaged within images before resampling. Registration errors are summarized by medians.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,结果是指从一万个复标中得出95%的负分率。 每个数据集估计重取图像;等位数据集摘要重取数据集再取图像. 任务特定分析重取推论种子(TTA),案例(BTXRD),或相匹配的标签-框架观测(观点-角度分析). MTDDH重复在再复制前在图像内平均. 登记错误按中位数汇总。

blocks.en: Paired t t -tests assess mean differences in Dice and Cobb-angle error between methods evaluated on the same images; Cobb comparisons require measurable predictions from both methods. Welch’s t t -test compares attenuation-related improvements between independent healthy and pneumonia groups. Registration errors are compared with Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, using ranks to limit the influence of extreme error magnitudes. Success and failure rates are reported descriptively. All tests are two-sided at α = \alpha={} 0.05. Reported p values are Holm-corrected across baseline comparisons or ablation pairs within datasets, within Cobb-angle severity strata, and across diagnostic conditions in the attenuation analysis.
blocks.zh: Paired t - t - tests 评估在同一图像上评价的方法在Dice和Cobb-angle中的平均差; Cobb 比较需要两种方法的可测量预测. Welch的t t测试比较了独立健康群体和肺炎群体之间与衰减相关的改善. 注册出错被比作威尔科克森签名排行测试,使用排行限制极端出错分级的影响. 成功率和失败率均以描述方式报告。 所有测试都是双面的 α =\ alpha = 0.05. 所报告的p值在数据集、Cobb-angle重度层和衰减分析中的诊断条件之间通过基线比较或减值对等进行Holm校正。

blocks.en: K.2 Implementation details
blocks.zh: K.2 执行细节

blocks.en: FleXray is trained using PyTorch [ 100 ] on NVIDIA H200 GPU nodes; each ensemble member trains on a single H200 for approximately 60–70 hours (roughly 320 GPU-hours for the ensemble). We use PyTorch automatic mixed precision (AMP) with bfloat16 autocasting for eligible forward-pass operations; model parameters and optimizer updates remain in FP32. We store our datasets in individual LMDB databases using thunderpack [ 101 ] in numpy [ 102 ] arrays. We store images and volumes as float16 arrays and segmentation labels as uint8 arrays. We generate projections from CTs using nanoDRR [ 23 ] ( https://github.com/eigenvivek/nanodrr ). Standard data augmentations were implemented with the Kornia library [ 103 ] . The MURA forearm and humerus subsets were annotated in CVAT [ 104 ] using SAM2 [ 98 ] as an interactive point-prompted segmentation tool, followed by manual polygon correction of every mask.
blocks.zh: FleXray在NVIDIA H200 GPU节点上使用PyTorch [100]进行训练;每节编组成员列车在单节H200上运行约60-70小时(每节编组大约为320GPU-hours). 我们使用 PyTorch 自动混合精度(AMP),对符合条件的前行通道操作进行bfloat16自动广播;模型参数和优化器更新仍保留于FP32. 我们使用雷克[101]将我们的数据集存储在单个的LMDB数据库中,以数字[102]阵列. 我们把图像和体积作为浮点16阵列和分块标签作为uint8阵列存储. 我们利用纳米DRR[23](https://github.com/eigenvivek/nanodrr.)从CT中生成预测。 与Kornia图书馆进行了标准数据扩充。 MURA前臂和humerus子集在CVAT[104]中被附加了注释,使用SAM2[98]作为交互点提示分解工具,然后对每个口罩进行手动多边形修正.

blocks.en: K.3 Anatomical coverage of public X-ray segmentation data
blocks.zh: K.3 公共X光分解数据的解剖覆盖

blocks.en: Figure 1 b summarizes the anatomical coverage of the public X-ray segmentation datasets we located, listed in Table 10 . Each dataset’s native labels are mapped into the 60-structure protocol as in Section A.4 , and an image counts toward a structure when it carries a mask of that structure, summed over the dataset’s partitions. For display, the protocol is collapsed to 25 regions: the individual vertebrae form the spine, the individual ribs form the ribs, and the clavicles are omitted. The distal radius and ulna visible in hand and wrist radiographs are not counted as coverage of those bones. The skeleton is the surface of one MOOSE subject’s label map, and each region is tinted by the logarithm of its image count on a shared color scale.
blocks.zh: 图1b概括了表10所列我们所发现的公共X射线分解数据集的解剖范围。 每个数据集的原生标签像A.4节一样被映入了60个结构协议中,当一个图像带有该结构的遮罩时,它就算向一个结构,然后在数据集的分区上加以概括。 为了展示,协议被倒塌到25个区域:单个的脊椎形成脊椎,单个的肋骨形成肋骨,而阴囊被省略. 手部和手腕放射图中可见的分光半径和乌拉不作为这些骨骼的覆盖。 骨架是一个MOOSE主题的标签图的表面,每个区域被其图像计数的对数用一个共享的颜色尺度来表示.

blocks.en: Table 10 : Public X-ray segmentation datasets behind Figure 1 b. Regions are the collapsed labels of Section K.3 that each dataset annotates. Labeled X-rays is the number of images carrying a mask of at least one listed region, summed over the dataset’s partitions. The radii and ulnae of the hand and wrist datasets are not counted because those radiographs show only the distal ends of the bones.
blocks.zh: 表10:图1b背后的公用X射线分解数据集. 区域是每个数据集注释的K.3节倒塌的标签. 标签X光是包含至少一个上市区域面具的图像数量, 手和手腕数据集的光圈和乌纳不计算,因为这些放射图只显示骨骼的分光端.
